title: Add regression test for union member strictness on an enum type
body:
## Change Summary

Adds a regression test for the scenario described in #10546: an `Annotated` enum with `strict=False` unioned with a `StringConstraints`-constrained `str`, inside a model configured with `strict=True`.

The reported behavior no longer reproduces on `main` — the snippet from the issue fails on v2.9.2/v2.10 but validates correctly on v2.11+, fixed by #11481 ("Support strict specification on union member types"). However, this specific scenario isn't covered by the existing tests (`test_union_respects_local_strict` only covers a `tuple` member), so this adds a test to prevent a regression.

## Related issue number

Fixes #10546
